test.create_query: CREATE TABLE reuse_join_keys_events (c1 LowCardinality(String), c2 Int64, c3 JSON, c4 DateTime64(3)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c1, c2, c4)
CREATE TABLE reuse_join_keys_dim (c5 Int64, c4 DateTime64(3), c6 Int64, c7 Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c6, c4)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO reuse_join_keys_events SELECT 'e1', number % 50000, concat('{{"k1":"v', toString(number % 20), '","k2":"', toString(number % 20000), '"', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat(',"f', toString(i), '":"', repeat('x', 20), toString(number % 97), '"'), range(10))), '}}'), toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalSecond(number % 1000000) FROM numbers(100000)
INSERT INTO reuse_join_keys_dim SELECT number, toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3), number % 1000, 1 FROM numbers(20000)
test.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(toString(e.c3), 'k1') AS a1, count(*) AS a2, countDistinct(JSONExtractString(toString(e.c3), 'k2')) AS a3, min(e.c4) AS a4, max(e.c4) AS a5, dateDiff('day', min(e.c4), max(e.c4)) AS a6 FROM reuse_join_keys_events AS e INNER JOIN reuse_join_keys_dim AS s ON JSONExtractString(toString(e.c3), 'k2') = toString(s.c5) WHERE (e.c1 = 'e1') AND (JSONExtractString(toString(e.c3), 'k1') != '') AND (s.c7 = 1) GROUP BY a1 ORDER BY a2 DESC FORMAT Null

SELECT count() FROM reuse_join_keys_events AS e INNER JOIN reuse_join_keys_dim AS s ON JSONExtractString(toString(e.c3), 'k2') = toString(s.c5) WHERE e.c1 = 'e1' AND JSONExtractString(toString(e.c3), 'k1') != '' FORMAT Null
